tools: GitHub CLI (gh), signed in, for pull request state; without it the update is built from git and what the engineer says
access: Jira access for the agent, through an MCP server or an API token, with permission to browse the project, add comments and transition issues; without it the update is handed over as text to paste

presentation.name: Update a Jira ticket from the real state of the work
presentation.summary: Moves a Jira ticket to the status that commits, pull requests and deployments support, and writes the comment that says what changed, where it is and what is left.
benefits: Finds the ticket from the branch, commits and pull request instead of searching by title
Chooses from the transitions the ticket's workflow actually offers, including the fields they require
Keeps merged, released and deployed apart, so a ticket is not closed ahead of the work
Writes the comment for the reporter and tester: the outcome, where it is, how to check it and what is left
Shows the transition and the comment first and writes to Jira only after confirmation
